tools.name: get_account
tools.description: Fetches customer account details, current available balance (USD), daily limits, and status.

tools.name: lookup_customer_by_phone
tools.description: Resolves a customer's banking identity, account ID, and verification status by phone number.

tools.name: transfer_to_phone
tools.description: Transfers funds from an authenticated customer's account to a recipient identified by phone number.

amount.description: Amount in USD to transfer (e.g., 250.0). Must be positive.

tools.name: pay_bill
tools.description: Pays a utility, telecom, or merchant bill directly from customer available balance.

account_number.description: Customer's reference account number with the biller.

amount.description: Amount in USD to pay towards the bill. Must be positive.

biller_name.description: Name of the billing institution or utility provider.

customer_id.description: Unique customer ID paying the bill.

tools.name: get_transaction_history
tools.description: Retrieves recent cleared transactions and ledger entries for an account.

limit.description: Maximum number of transactions to return.
